vision: Transform legacy repositories into structured, indexable intelligence for agents and humans via SDD and LLM orchestration.
architectural_style: Clean Architecture + DDD, Event-Driven API with Asynchronous AI Worker Clusters

key_components.name: LLMBudgetService
key_components.role: Gatekeeper, cost-tracking strictly enforcing token budget per job via PostgreSQL auditing.

key_components.name: StackDetector
key_components.role: Runs specfy CLI in subproccess. Emits core tech stack without LLM guessing.

key_components.name: ContextBuilder
key_components.role: Graph-based hierarchy scorer mapping repo tree into valuable chunks, discarding boilerplate.

key_components.name: SystemMapper
key_components.role: Evaluates dominant architecture, mixed styles, domain boundaries.

key_components.name: TechDebtAnalyzer
key_components.role: Ph1: Linters (Go, Py, Eslint) Ph2: LLM reasoning correlating systemic vulnerabilities and tech debt clusters.

key_components.name: DocWritingLayer
key_components.role: 4 Parallel Agents building Tech, Human, AI-Spec and Debt Markdowns/JSON output structures.

key_components.name: IntelligenceInterface
key_components.role: FastAPI REST API exposing 6 operational domain points (Understanding, Navigation, Context, Impact, Docs, Guided Intelligence)

crucial_rules: No LLM usage for deterministic extraction/tree building.
Every LLM prompt strictly requires prior clearance from LLMBudgetService.
Strict separation between extraction, correlation/mapping, and documentation artifacts.
open_gaps: RAG Vectorization method (PgVector vs ChromaDB) missing definition
Timeouts configuration for asynchronous heavy jobs (Broker missing def)
Exact MCP Protocol wrapper spec vs Local Standalone Host
